subject.title: Windows QuickStart defaults first chat to paid Anthropic model without credit warning

question: What should Anthropic QuickStart do before launching the first terminal chat when the selected default is an Opus/API-key path that may require paid credits?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but changing provider defaults, adding confirmation, or adding billing preflight changes first-run UX and provider-cost policy, which needs maintainer intent before automation should patch it.

options.title: Require pre-hatch billing confirmation
options.body: Keep Anthropic available, but warn about Opus/API-key billing and require explicit confirmation or a model change before the first terminal chat launches.

options.title: Change the default model
options.body: Move Anthropic first-run setup to a lower-cost default and require explicit user selection for Opus-class models.

options.title: Improve failure copy only
options.body: Leave the Opus default unchanged and only make first-chat billing failures clearer, accepting that users may still discover the credit requirement after setup.

recommendation.title: Require pre-hatch billing confirmation
recommendation.body: Keep Anthropic available, but warn about Opus/API-key billing and require explicit confirmation or a model change before the first terminal chat launches.

likelyOwner.reason: The default-policy history points to steipete, and this is a provider default/product decision rather than a narrow implementation defect.
